role: Post-hoc compartment-level re-aggregation of the locked Stage 2 annotation. Moves the estimand from terminal immune type to the annotation level whose pre-declared agreement gate passed (L2, kappa=0.9959). Changes no panel, gene, threshold, delta, resolution, SESOI, model term or existing K=9 family.
sha256_algorithm: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of posthoc_compartment_plan.md; verify with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256

derives_from.note: Re-aggregates the frozen Stage 2 per-cell labels; the Stage 2 model, SESOI formula and evaluability rule are reused verbatim.

locked_before: Any compartment-level interaction estimate, permutation p-value or equivalence classification had been computed or viewed. The Stage 1 and Stage 2 terminal-type estimates and the Stage 2 annotation gate outcome were already known and this is disclosed in section 1 of the plan.
deviation_policy: Any further change requires a dated, hashed amendment written before the affected computation. Outcome-driven retuning after a compartment estimate has been viewed is prohibited.
